svg.metadata: {"story":"Joshua","act":2,"chapter":"Ch.2 · Rahab and the Spies","scene":"B","layer":"foreground","artDirection":"Two spies are hidden by Rahab the prostitute on the wall of Jericho, and she marks the scarlet cord in the window.
